about.title: About Me
descriptions: Software Developer with 5+ years of experience building web, mobile, and SaaS products using TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

I've worked with startups, agencies, and product teams, designing and developing software across the entire product lifecycle—from architecture and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

I enjoy building software that solves real business problems. Beyond writing code, I'm interested in product thinking, software architecture, user experience, AI-powered features, and creating systems that remain maintainable as they grow.

experiences.title: Dam Squad
descriptions: I'm part of the Dam Squad IT team alongside the CTO, building and maintaining custom software solutions for ongoing clients.

At Amparo Seguros I lead the development of their digital products, including a React Native app for insurance agents, backend services, and internal tools for certificate issuance and business operations.
At Red SOS I develop and maintain their institutional websites and digital platforms.

experiences.title: Capsule Codes
descriptions: Built web and mobile products from scratch for international clients across multiple industries.

Contributed to UR POV, a mobile reviews platform for the South African market, an educational platform focused on investing and personal finance, and the company's SaaS project management platform featuring time tracking, invoicing, and Kanban workflows.

experiences.title: Helmcode
descriptions: Developed Andulia, an AI agent capable of managing AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure through natural language.
Contributed to HelmCloud, a container-based cloud platform designed to reduce infrastructure costs for startups and SMBs.
Worked on Coderun, a SaaS platform for deploying and managing containerized services with GitHub, GitLab, and Docker integration. I also developed the company's institutional website.

experiences.title: Potentiality Group
descriptions: Worked as a Software Developer within the IT teams of Iúnigo and San Cristóbal Seguros.
At Iúnigo I developed and maintained the customer mobile app, the main website, the online insurance quoting platform, and digital products focused on self-service experiences.
At San Cristóbal Seguros I contributed to the multi-product quoting platform, the insurance broker portal, and the rollout of these systems for the Uruguayan market.

experiences.title: Vippin
descriptions: Built the institutional website for Clínica Universitaria Reina Fabiola from scratch.
Developed a proxy API connecting Salesforce with the frontend for a Telefónica España project.
Contributed to a tourism application for the Ministry of Tourism of Villa Carlos Paz featuring Google Maps integration and Beacon-based geolocation.
